symbols.reasoning: Replays request-derived expense before validation. New command restricts source to Protected accounts, amount positive and category/description nonblank, loads actor and Open shift before transaction. Authorization branches Drawer vs any non-Drawer account; optional approval ignored for non-Drawer by policy, not bypass. Active day prechecked, then source balance locked/rechecked inside transaction, journal/movement/expense/audit and voucher job committed together. BusinessDate and CreatedAt derive SAME now, rejecting invented arbitrary backdating. Shift/day can close after precheck, but source liquidity remains serialized. Cancellation or unhandled validation aborts transaction; conflict recovery same key only.
